Foreign Affairs /////
January, 29. 1943.

Application to Carry/Keep Firearms, by
Joseph Spalter, German Jewish Refugee.

With reference to the attached application for per-
mission to carry/keep firearms , by Joseph Spalter, Ger-
man Jewish Refugee, discrete enquiries were made in re-
spect to his personality and the following was ascertai-
ned:

Joseph S P A L T E R, German Jewish Refugees, marr-
ied, born on the 17-th of April, 1908, in Dresden,
Germany, arrived in Shanghai on the 7-th of April,
1939, on the S/S "TERUKUNI MARU", in possession
of a "Stateless" passport, No. 1603/38, issued in
Dresden, which was changed at the "I.C." organiza-
tion to a "Document of Identification" No.3355,
this latter mentioned document was confiscated by
the S.M.Police(D.S.I. Pitts) and is at this office.
The applicant is at present in possession of Receipt
stating that he has applied for a U.S.S.R. passport.
This receipt was issued on the 3-rd of February,
1942, by the U.S.S.R. Consulate General in Shanghai,
but bears the chop of the U.S.S.R. Embassy in Tokio.
He is a chemical engineer by profession, specialis-
ing in leather chemistry and graduated the "Kaiser
Wilhelm Institute" in Dresden. In Shanghai he was
a partner of the "Hygienic Manufacturing Co." 2
Peking Road, which went into liquidation, and had a
also a flat No.262/4 Hamilton House in October,1941
however is has been stated that this flat was actu-
ally the flat of Mr. Shimizu, Japanese, formerly 1/
of the Municipal Orchestra, but on J. Spalters name.
Joseph Spalter is married to Steffy Epstein. His
father-in-law, Epstein, reported to the "I.C." in
1941 that he was not responsible for debts incurred
by his daughter or son-in-law, because J. Spalter
had incurred debts with the liquidation of the "Hy-
gienic Manufacturing Co".
J. Spalter resides at present at 75/2 Tifeng Rd
and is employed as an German interpreter to Mr.
Wang Wei Chow(王惠周) alias Wang Hong Dag(王鸿达)
with offices at 135 Yuen Ming Yuen Road, Room 302,
which office is also used by J. Spalter.
Mr. Wong Wei Chow is the secretary for Mr. Robert
V. W. Wang,E., an high official of the Banking Gove
rnment, residing at No. 4 Yao Yuen off Shanghai Roa
Banking, c/o Mrs Ting. J.Spalter obtained his pre-
sent employment approximately in December 1941.
He drives M/car licence No. 30635, Ford Roadster
Frequents the "Barcelona", 326 Avenue du Roi Albert,
F.C., where he meets various persons of German and
Russian Soviet citizens, also Chinese Communists
as reported. He also frequents the bars and restaur
ants in the Western Area.

1943年3月30日

外事科 /////
1943年1月29日。

德籍犹太难民约瑟夫·斯帕尔特（Joseph Spalter）申请携带/持有枪支。

关于所附德籍犹太难民约瑟夫·斯帕尔特申请许可携带/持有枪支一事，已对其人品进行了 discreet enquiries（审慎调查），查明情况如下：

约瑟夫·S·P·A·L·T·E·R，德籍犹太难民，已婚，1908年4月17日出生于德国德累斯顿，于1939年4月7日乘坐“照国丸”号（S/S "TERUKUNI MARU"）抵达上海，持有一本在德累斯顿签发的“无国籍”护照，编号1603/38，该护照已在“国际委员会”（I.C.）组织更换为编号3355的“身份证明书”，后一份提及的文件已被上海公共租界工部局警务处（警探长皮茨 D.S.I. Pitts）没收，现存于本办公室。申请人目前持有一份收据，表明其已申请苏联护照。该收据由苏联驻上海总领事馆于1942年2月3日签发，但盖有苏联驻东京大使馆的印章。其职业为化学工程师，专攻皮革化学，毕业于德累斯顿的“威廉皇帝研究所”（Kaiser Wilhelm Institute）。在上海，他曾是北京路2号“卫生制造公司”（Hygienic Manufacturing Co.）的合伙人，该公司已清算；此外，他在1941年10月还拥有一套位于汉密尔顿公寓（Hamilton House）262/4号的公寓，然而据称该公寓实际上是前工部局乐队成员之一、日籍人士清水先生（Mr. Shimizu）的公寓，只是登记在J. 斯帕尔特名下。约瑟夫·斯帕尔特的妻子是斯特菲·爱泼斯坦（Steffy Epstein）。其岳父爱泼斯坦于1941年向“国际委员会”报告称，他对女儿或女婿所欠债务不承担责任，因为J. 斯帕尔特在“卫生制造公司”清算过程中产生了债务。
J. 斯帕尔特目前居住在提封路75/2号，受雇为王惠周（Wang Wei Chow，别名王鸿达 Wang Hong Dag）担任德语翻译，王的办公地点位于圆明园路135号302室，J. 斯帕尔特也使用该办公室。
王惠周先生是罗伯特·V·W·王爵士（Robert V. W. Wang, E.）的秘书，王爵士是银行界政府高官，寓居上海路耀元弄4号，由丁太太转交。J. 斯帕尔特大约在1941年12月获得目前的职位。
他驾驶牌照号为30635的福特敞篷跑车。
常去法租界阿尔贝国王路326号的“巴塞罗那”（Barcelona）咖啡馆，据报在那里他会见各类德国人、苏联公民以及中国共产党员。他也常去西区（Western Area）的酒吧和餐馆。

He obtained from the French Concession Police
on the 7-th of September, 1942, a licence to
carry/keep firearms No.2186, for the same auto-
pistol Cal. 25, French make, which was given to
him by Mr. Henry Yang, P/A to Major General C.C
Pan, i/c of Western Shanghai Police Force.
Mr. Henry Yang resides at 346 Avenue Haig, Tel.
No. 23155 & 23156.

On the strenght of the above enquiries it can be state
that J. Stapler although employed as an official of the
Nanking Governement and therefore it appears that there
should not be objection to his application to carry/keep
firearms . However having applied for a Soviet passport
shows defenitly that he is of anty-Axis political views
and suspected agent for the U.S.S.R. Consulate, having
good connections amongst the Jewish Refugees in Shanghai

Joseph Stapler associates with Nathan Rabin and other
persons of doubtful character and the meeting place is
at the "Barcelona" cafe, 326 Avenue du Roi Albert, where
political and other views are exchanged. His name was
mentioned with the murder of Captain Rolland Kerrwein
in November, 1942. (Please see File I40 (C) ).

The undersigned respectfully submits this report for
consideration as to the advisableness of granting a
licence to carry/keep firearms to the applicant.

D.S.I.

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs Section,
Crime & Special Branches.

（续）。
他于1942年9月7日从法租界巡捕房获得携带/持有枪支许可证，编号2186，用于同一支25口径法国制自动手枪，该枪由潘公展少将（Major General C.C Pan，上海西部警察部队主管）的私人助理亨利·杨（Henry Yang）先生赠予。
亨利·杨先生居住在海格路346号，电话23155及23156。

基于上述调查，可以指出，J. 斯帕尔特（原文误拼为 Stapler）虽受雇于南京政府官员，因此看来对其申请携带/持有枪支不应有异议。然而，其申请苏联护照一事明确显示他持有反轴心国的政治观点，且涉嫌为苏联领事馆代理人，在上海的犹太难民中拥有良好的人脉关系。

约瑟夫·斯帕尔特（原文误拼为 Stapler）与内森·拉宾（Nathan Rabin）及其他品行可疑的人士交往，会面地点为阿尔贝国王路326号的“巴塞罗那”咖啡馆，在此交换政治及其他观点。他的名字曾与1942年11月罗兰·克尔温上尉（Captain Rolland Kerrwein）被杀案有关联。（请参阅档案 I40 (C)）。

谨呈此报告，供考量是否宜向申请人颁发携带/持有枪支许可证。

警探长（D.S.I.）

罪案及特务科外事股主管警官
